== Card credits ==
Geoff Dearing is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of one card.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The printed concept credit names the tournament or award with the concept: "Utah States 2009" on •I Hope She's All Right (V) ([[Virtual Block 7]]). The credited card was printed in [[Virtual Block 7]] (2010). The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Geoff Dearing|Card Credits]].
